thread:
michael: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups for last night's observability incidents (missing spans, bad aggregation, ETL lag). I'll enumerate owners and timelines. Ack and call out anything missing.
carla: Ack. I'll take the pipeline/span backfill coordination.
tara: Ack. I'll own dashboard/alert changes and a regression check.
lee: On it — will look at the ETL job pagination regression and post a PR.
michael: Action items (short):
- CARLA: pipeline backfill for the affected window (2026-03-22 00:00–06:00). Backfill dry-run on staging, then prod backfill. Ticket INF-4321. Due 2026-03-25.
- LEE: fix ingest timestamp alignment in the rollup job (root cause: list pagination changed ingestion ordering) + add unit/regression test. Push patch and CI test. Due 2026-03-24.
- TARA: add aggregation validation alert (hourly compare rollups -> ground truth) + update dashboards to show divergence metric. Add runbook. Due 2026-03-24.
- MICHAEL: create a weekly postmortem check-in on calendar and a short recurring Grafana dashboard review to catch patterns. Due 2026-03-23.
- CARLA & LEE: revert/lock trace-agent sampling config in prod and add config-integration test to prevent future missing spans. Due 2026-03-23.
michael: Please paste PRs/JIRA when ready; we'll mark INF-4321 as the parent action tracker.
carla: Plan for backfill: staging dry-run tonight, snapshot of metric divergence, then run backfill in a 1-hour maintenance window. Will paste dry-run log.
carla: dry-run snippet (staging):
```
2026-03-22T02:14:03Z INFO backfill: processed 42k events, divergence=0.0023
2026-03-22T02:20:11Z INFO backfill: checkpoint persisted at seq=987654
```
tara: For the alert I'll create a synthetic hourly job that computes two aggregations (streaming vs batch). If divergence > 0.1% for 3 consecutive hours -> fire pager and create a ticket.
lee: Root cause for ETL lag: S3 list pagination regression introduced in commit 7f2d7a3 — we were reordering keys during pagination, which caused some late batches to be skipped until the next run. PR #548 is ready with the pagination fix + golden-file test. I'll push a hotfix and then a follow-up integration test.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline-rollup-fix (PR #548) scheduled to canary at 2026-03-23T08:00:00Z.
incident-bot: Reminder: weekly action-checkin created (INF-4321) — next meeting 2026-03-30 15:00 UTC.
michael: Thanks everyone. Key success criteria: backfill reduces divergence to <0.05% and no missing spans reported in the next 72h. Update INF-4321 as you complete items and tag me. If dry-run shows >0.1% divergence we abort prod backfill and investigate further.
carla: Will update INF-4321 with dry-run logs and a tentative maintenance window.
tara: I'll attach the runbook and alert links to the ticket.
lee: I'll post PR #548 link and roll forward the canary once CI is green.
michael: Closing loop for now — expect short status updates in this thread. Thanks. :thumbsup:
